subject: Final-mile activation orchestration: API keys & network gating
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Richardson <ava.richardson@novacare.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final-mile activation orchestration: API keys & network gating

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions last week. We’re ready to move Novacare into the final activation sprint and want to confirm the minimal set of items required in the MAP to clear POC readiness. See the short checklist below and proposed owners/timelines: (attached: MAP-v2.pdf, network-template.xlsx)

Quick MAP checklist / pre-kickoff asks (target: kick off week of 9/6):
- Org identifier and the user account that will own the Redwood org (Novacare org_id or admin email). — due EOD 9/5 — owner: Novacare
- API key generation: create a scoped service account/API key for the POC with token rotation instructions. — due EOD 9/5 — owner: Novacare
- IP allowlist for outbound traffic to Redwood endpoints (CIDR list). — due 9/6 — owner: Novacare security
- VPC peering request (if you want private peering) with preferred maintenance window & peering CIDRs — due 9/7 — owner: Novacare infra
- Signed MSA or DocuSign link for the POC terms (if procurement needs it before we reserve Dedicated slots). — as available — owner: procurement

Operational notes:
- If peering is not approved in time, we’ll fall back to API key + strict IP allowlist (no VPC peering) for the POC to keep latency predictable.
- Grace (cc’d) will own run-of-show and the activation checklist from Redwood’s side. Neha will lead security attestation items.

Proposed 30-min kickoff windows (pick one):
- Tue 9/7 09:00-09:30 PT
- Tue 9/7 13:30-14:00 PT
- Wed 9/8 10:00-10:30 PT

Please reply with: org_id, one preferred kickoff window, and any known blockers for peering. I’ve attached a short network template to make it easy for your infra team to paste values.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Ava Richardson <ava.richardson@novacare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security.team@novacare.com, procurement@novacare.com
Date: 2026-09-04T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile activation orchestration: API keys & network gating

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick updates from our side:
- Org: novacare-prod (we'll share the exact admin email out-of-band — security asked we redeliver via their ticketing system).
- API key: Procurement will generate a scoped service account, but they asked for an example permission set. Can you confirm minimal scopes?
- IP allowlist: security team provided the following outbound ranges to allow to Redwood endpoints: 34.201.20.0/24, 52.12.128.0/20 (they asked I include the full list once the infra lead is at the table).
- VPC peering: security is open to peering but needs a short runbook and a maintenance window. They prefer Wed 9/8 after 18:00 ET.
- MSA: procurement asked for a DocuSign link; can you send that so we can route internally?

I can do Tue 9/7 13:30-14:00 PT for the kickoff if that works for your team.

Thanks —
Ava
Director, Cloud Integrations | Novacare Health

On 2026-09-04 09:12, Jordan Blake wrote:
> Hi Ava —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions last week. We’re ready to move Novacare into the final activation sprint...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Richardson <ava.richardson@novacare.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile activation orchestration: API keys & network gating

Thanks, Ava — helpful.

Neha and I talked through our side's runbook; I attached a short activation checklist for your security/infra teams (gr-team-activation-checklist.txt) to mirror your internal steps. Minimal scopes for the POC API key: token-only ingestion + query (no billing admin, no write-to-customer-storage). We’ll provide a sample IAM policy in the kickoff if that helps.

Ownership & immediate next actions (to close before kickoff 9/7/13:30 PT):
- Novacare: share admin email/org_id via security ticket; provide full IP CIDR list. (Ava) — due 9/05
- Novacare Procurement: create scoped service account and start DocuSign routing (Marcus will be looped in). (procurement@novacare.com) — due ASAP
- Redwood (Grace): prepare peering runbook + sample route table entries — deliver 9/06 EOD
- Redwood (Neha): compile brief security attestation (data flow diagram + retention notes) — deliver 9/06 EOD

If Wed 9/8 after 18:00 ET is the only peering window, we can support it; for the initial POC we’ll keep the API-key + allowlist flow as Plan A so the kick will not be blocked.

—
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Richardson <ava.richardson@novacare.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, procurement@novacare.com
Date: 2026-09-04T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile activation orchestration: API keys & network gating

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming we’ll take Tue 9/7 13:30-14:00 PT as the kickoff. I’ve added a short pre-kick checklist below so the meeting can be strictly execution-focused. (I also uploaded the MSA to DocuSign; link saved as docusign-MSA-link.txt)

Pre-kick checklist (please complete before 9/7 13:30 PT):
- Novacare: share admin email or org_id in your security ticket (or directly to Jordan) — REQUIRED
- Novacare: provide final IP allowlist (full CIDR set) — PREFERRED
- Procurement: initiate DocuSign routing and add Marcus as the Redwood contact — PREFERRED
- Redwood: deliver peering runbook + security attestation (Grace/Neha) — DONE (attached)

Calendar / kickoff: https://calendly.com/redwood/jb-novacare-kickoff (scheduled for Tue 2026-09-07 13:30 PT)
DocuSign (MSA): https://docusign.example.com/s/start/xxxx-msa-placeholder
HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.ai/hubspot/deal/4572

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to a smooth activation.

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
